mentions.name: CofferDam
mentions.description: A Rust-based CLI tool that parses the AST of a codebase and enforces architectural preferences, such as not reimplementing design system components and following DRY principles.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://tajd.github.io/cofferdam/ which is a rust based cli tool I wrote to parse the ast of codebase and enforce architectural preferences - eg don’t reimplement design system for components down to DRY
mentions.author: tajd

mentions.name: Cofferdam
mentions.description: This tool enforces code architecture and conventions, runs very quickly, and is designed to be easily extendable.
mentions.source_excerpt: A tool for enforcing code architecture and conventions - https://tajd.github.io/cofferdam/ - these sorts of tools come along every week, but this one is mine and it's v quick to run and extendable.
mentions.author: tajd
